title: complete_delivery skips message state update for kind='receipt'
description: complete_delivery checks if entry.kind=='receipt' and only deletes outbox row, skipping messages.delivery_state update. Correct because: receipts are remote read metadata, not local delivery state; advancing state counter would create false Message/changes notifications; receiver's message view remains stable. Alternative: updating messages.delivery_state rejected because would incorrectly signal message change to JMAP clients via Message/changes.
